_about: Communication pathways for the MATCH step. Channels and owners are proposals – supports, does not replace, county and State public-information plans. Languages come from data/sources/languages_by_county.csv (ACS PUMS 2019-2023, detailed languages; Kauai and Maui share one PUMA and one language list). ACS C16001 (languages_by_county_c16001.csv) is kept as a secondary source.
status: proposed – supports, does not replace, county plans

channels.description: Official alerts: Wireless Emergency Alerts / Emergency Alert System and county alert sign-ups
Broadcast radio, including in-language programs where available
Trusted community messengers: faith-based groups, Native Hawaiian organizations, health care providers, community nonprofits
Printed notices at shelters, libraries and schools, in the county's top languages

message_library.rule: AI drafts may be committed only as status 'DRAFT – …' with approved = no and reviewed_by empty. A message may be used only after a named human reviewer (reviewed_by, review_date) approves it (approved = yes): a county public information officer for English, a native speaker for every translation. Messages make no promises the counties have not made.
message_library.draft_status_translation: DRAFT – AI translation, needs native-speaker review
message_library.draft_status_english: DRAFT – AI-drafted English source, needs county review
message_library.no_ai_draft_status: NEEDS HUMAN TRANSLATION – no reliable AI draft for this language
